device.title: What should open
device.description:
Pick the garage door, gate, switch, script or lock.

**Repeat protection** decides when the same car may move the door again. Each choice has a risk; you choose:

• **Cooldown only** (recommended): nothing moves within the cooldown of the door last moving. *Risk:* a car parked in view for longer than the cooldown, still tracked by Frigate, can trigger the door again.

• **Cooldown + once per Frigate event**: as above, and the same Frigate tracking event can only act once. *Risk:* Frigate can start a NEW event for the same car (a bad frame, someone walking in front of the camera, the car leaving view and coming back, pulling forward to fetch something and reversing again), and a new event may trigger the door again once the cooldown allows.

**Only while moving** (off by default): ignore cars Frigate marks as stationary. *Risk:* a car that stops before its plate is read is missed, and a slow arrival can be marked stationary.

**Locks:** unlocking a door for a number plate is a bigger step than opening a garage. A photo of your plate, or a similar plate, could unlock it. You must tick the disclaimer to use a lock, and you accept that ElectriFix and this software carry no responsibility for entry gained this way.

data.open_on_arrival: Open when a known plate arrives (door closed → open)
data.close_on_leaving: Close when a known plate leaves (door open → close)
data.cooldown_seconds: Cooldown after the door last moved
data.require_moving: Only act while the car is moving (ignore parked cars)
data.auto_close_minutes: Close (or re-lock) again after this many minutes if Plate Gate opened it (0 = off)
data.lock_acknowledged: Lock disclaimer: I understand a plate read can unlock my door and I accept the risk

frigate_yaml.title: Tell Frigate about the plates
frigate_yaml.description:
Plate Gate is set up. Now paste this into your Frigate `config.yml` at the top level and restart Frigate (restarting pauses detection for about a minute):

```yaml
{yaml}
```

Tips for **{camera}**:

• Set `detect` to the camera's real stream size. It is currently {detect}. Plates are small; every pixel counts.

• Don't mask the street. Tracking a car as it turns in gives the plate reader a head start.

• Plate Gate starts in **dry run**: it logs what it *would* do. Turn dry run off once the *Last action* sensor looks right for a few days.

Stuck? ElectriFix can set this up for you: {help_url}

benchmark.title: Benchmark detection models
benchmark.description:
Plate Gate switches Frigate to each candidate in turn, lets it run on your live cameras for the minutes you choose, records speed and skipped frames, then puts your original config back.

⚠️ **Each candidate is one Frigate restart** (detection pauses ~30–60 s each time). The model files must already be on the Frigate machine; the hardware screen gives the install command. A candidate whose file is missing simply fails and is skipped.{report}

data.ack: I understand Frigate will restart once per candidate and the files must already be in place

install_model.title: Install a detection model
install_model.description:
The Companion **{companion}** will download the file from {source}, check its checksum and put it where Frigate reads models. Nothing in Frigate changes until you write the settings (Configure → Write) or run the benchmark.

These files are GPL-3.0 conversions of the YOLOv9 authors' released weights; licence and sources are in the README.

data.source: Download from (advanced: leave as is unless you host the files yourself; the Companion only accepts sources on its allow-list)

accuracy.title: Accuracy check on your own footage
accuracy.description:
The Companion **{companion}** runs each model you tick over the most recent event snapshots of **{camera}** and counts the frames where it found a vehicle. Runs on the Frigate machine's CPU for a few minutes; Frigate keeps working.

{note}

abort.busy: Another Frigate operation (a write, restore or benchmark) is still running. Try again in a minute.
abort.admin_required: Frigate's config routes need its admin login. Reconfigure Plate Gate with the Frigate admin username and password (port 8971), or use the unauthenticated port 5000.
abort.auth_required: Frigate wants a login. Reconfigure Plate Gate with the Frigate username and password.
abort.bad_yaml: Frigate's config.yml could not be read as YAML, so Plate Gate won't touch it. Fix it in Frigate's config editor first.
abort.nothing_to_change: Frigate already has these settings. Nothing to write.
abort.no_backups: No backups yet: Plate Gate hasn't written to this Frigate.
abort.not_loaded: Plate Gate isn't running. Reload it and try again.
abort.no_companion: No Plate Gate Companion is online. Install it next to Frigate (Home Assistant OS: the add-on from the ElectriFix add-on repository; Docker: the companion container), then try again. Without it, the hardware screen gives you a one-line command to run yourself.
abort.no_models: The Companion has no model files yet. Use Install model first.
